title: RAII and Resource Cleanup
learningObjectives: Explain the main rules of RAII resource ownership.
Identify the key C++ constructs used for RAII resource ownership.
Apply RAII resource ownership in a small program.
Recognize common failure cases and safety concerns.
Test a practical scenario and justify the chosen approach.

understand.concept: RAII ties a resource to an object's lifetime. Resource-owning objects acquire during construction and release in destructors. Standard examples include streams, vector, unique_ptr and lock_guard.
understand.whyItMatters: Automatic cleanup works on normal return and exception paths, preventing leaks and forgotten unlock/close operations.
